_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Every key is optional — defaults live in loomy2api/config.py. Environment variables override this file (see README). 改完保存即热生效（面板「在线配置」也能改）。
_access_key: Leave empty to use the constants shipped with the official client. Override if your client ships a different pair.
_proxy: empty = direct connection (recommended for these domestic endpoints)
_api_keys: empty list = the gateway needs no key. Set e.g. ["sk-abc"] to require Bearer/x-api-key. 首启自动生成时这里会是随机 Key。
_models: Upstream model ids are used verbatim — no alias table. See GET /v1/models for the catalogue.
_pool: accounts_file holds your accounts (gitignored). strategy: weighted | balance | round_robin | lru
_identity: per_account = each account gets its own devid + promotions device id, bound on first login; client = mirror the shipped client exactly (devid: web)
_routing: 选号/冷却/粘性（借鉴 workbuddy2api-panel）。weighted = 三因子加权(余额×10 + 闲置×1 + 成功率×3) Top-N 抽签，防惊群。
_sticky: 同一会话尽量落在同一账号，保住多轮上下文；0 = 关闭
_inflight: 单账号在途请求上限（0 = 不限）。账号被并发打爆时设 1~3。
_security: 面板响应加 CSP/nosniff 等安全头；首启自动生成 config.json（含随机 api_key）
